name: calamine-cell-comments
instr:
Please add worksheet cell comments to calamine, separate from cell values. Don't add new crates.

Expose `calamine::CellComment` with public fields `row: u32`, `col: u32`, `author: Option<String>`, `text: String`. Add inherent methods `Xlsx::worksheet_comments(&mut self, name: &str) -> Result<Vec<CellComment>, XlsxError>`, `Ods::worksheet_comments(&mut self, name: &str) -> Result<Vec<CellComment>, OdsError>`, and `Sheets::worksheet_comments(&mut self, name: &str) -> Result<Vec<CellComment>, Error>`. `Sheets` delegates XLSX/ODS; XLS/XLSB return errors.

Coordinates are zero-based and absolute. Include empty comments; unknown sheets error, comment-free sheets return empty vectors. Calls are repeatable, independent of `HeaderRow`, range trimming, data/formula reads. Annotation text never enters values, formulas or range bounds.

For XLSX, follow every internal worksheet `/relationships/comments` relationship in document order, ignoring external and threaded relationships. Resolve targets relative to the worksheet part, normalizing `.`/`..`; leading `/` means archive root. Read each normalized part once, at its first occurrence. Authors are local to each part. Missing relationships mean no comments; missing parts, malformed XML, missing/invalid cell references error, even when another part succeeds. References must be single A1 cells within 1,048,576 rows and 16,384 columns. Map `authorId` into authors; absent/out-of-range IDs give `None`, empty authors `Some("")`. Concatenate `<
